description: Restores an app's data from Neblla's daily copies (7 days, 30 with Pro). restore: EVERYTHING in that environment (saves, tables, inbox, community, chat, rooms) goes back to that day; purchases stay. The current data is kept 7 days for undo. Locks the app a few seconds, costs quota, runs in the background (neblla_backups_read status). replay_held applies writes set aside while the store was full. Owner only; not with the developer's own database. More: neblla_get_llms tools/backups

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

confirm.description: true runs it; without it nothing changes and the answer says what would be lost. Only after the developer agreed.

confirmEmpty.description: restore: only to empty the app on purpose when the day's copy holds none of it.

date.description: restore: YYYY-MM-DD, one of neblla_backups_read list's days.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, default) or "pre" (the private test copy).

force.description: replay_held: also overwrite saves players made after their writes were set aside.

key.description: replay_held: the key of a held package from neblla_backups_read list.

name: neblla_backups
title: Manage backups
